title: Integer density g∘H⁻¹ of a Lipschitz image piece and its area-formula bound (supplied steps 4–5)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L ≥ 0, let H : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz, and let B ⊆ ℝⁿ be Borel such that H is injective on B and differentiable with injective derivative DH(a) = fderiv ℝ H a at every a ∈ B. Let g : ℝⁿ → ℤ be measurable and Lebesgue integrable on B, with g(u) ≠ 0 for every u ∈ B. Then there is a measurable m : ℝ^P → ℝ with m(y) ∈ ℤ for every y and m(H(u)) = g(u) for every u ∈ B, such that Hⁿ(H(B)) < ∞ and ∫⁻_{H(B)} |m| dHⁿ ≤ Lⁿ·∫⁻_B |g| dλ in [0, ∞], where Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P and λ is Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid n → ℤ), LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet B → InjOn H B → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → Measurable g → IntegrableOn (fun u => (g u : ℝ)) B → (∀ u ∈ B, g u ≠ 0) → ∃ m : Euclid P → ℝ, Measurable m ∧ (∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, m y = z) ∧ (∀ u ∈ B, m (H u) = g u) ∧ μHE[n] (H '' B) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∫⁻ y in H '' B, ‖m y‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * ∫⁻ u in B, ‖(g u : ℝ)‖ₑ
